workbench-task.title: Task context
workbench-task.empty: Choose a task to view its delivery context alongside your files.
workbench-task.boundary: This is task reference context. It does not bind this editor's directory to the task's execution workspace or start work.
workbench-task.test_boundary: Counts describe the original published test plan. Independent code sources, workers and formal review must be checked in the original evidence.

workbench-task.bounded: Loaded: {{loaded}} of {{total}}. Open the original source for the full scope.
workbench-task.no_team_plan: No expert-team plan recorded for this run.
workbench-task.design.current: The adopted design basis is current.
workbench-task.design.stale: The adopted design basis has changed. Review the original version.
workbench-task.design.unknown: The design basis could not be confirmed.
workbench-task.navigation_blocked: Finish or reconcile the current edit before changing context or opening another page.
workbench-task.access_changed: Access changed. Task context and search results have been hidden. Retry to check current access.
workbench-task.invalid_context: The task context does not match the current project, task version or original facts. Refresh to continue.
workbench-task.invalid_page: The task list does not match the current project or search. Search again.
